headline: The Lewis Hall (£5.3m) dilemma. Are we actually trusting Newcastle's defence for this 3-game run?
body: Sitting at over 20% ownership, but owning him has been an absolute rollercoaster. That 13-pointer against Hull bailed a lot of us out, but dropping doughnuts against Leeds and Coventry was brutal. Looking at the next three: CRY (A), EVE (H), FUL (A). On paper, it’s a great run to hold him for before they hit Arsenal in GW11. But is anyone actually confident in a Newcastle clean sheet away at Palace, or is he just a £5.3m trap that we are too scared to sell? For those who own him, are you holding for the attacking upside or moving the funds elsewhere?   submitted by   /u/DevFPL [link]   [comments]
